item.title: Security bollards not deployed, 19th November
item.description:
Earlier today just before 14:00 I observed that the security bollards were down (not deployed) at the southern end of the pedestrianised high street, I waited for several minutes, there was no vehicular traffic present in either direction. The high street was very busy with perhaps hundreds of people, I wouldn’t want to be the person responsible for the lack of deployment if there was a serious vehicle based terrorist attack. We should learn from recent events!

item.title: Dog poo near children's play area and nearby, 19th November
item.description:
I've just approached a woman (blonde, late 20s to 30s) walking an unneutered XL Bully on the estate, as I've seen her on multiple occasions allowing her dog to foul the grassy area near the children's play area without cleaning up after it. When I raised this with her, she simply shrugged and said she didn't have a poo bag. However, I witnessed her doing exactly the same thing just last week, so this appears to be a regular occurrence.

item.title: Abandoned car for 5 weeks now, 19th November
item.description:
